title: The Prayer From Affliction
description: The seal upon the heart. T100 stands at the center of the coda — a long teaching parallel to T15 in the seeking-section, but where T15 narrated the macro-redemption from the inmost outward, T100 narrates it as prayer from within affliction. The Mother of Life cries out for the First Man held in great affliction; the Father receives the prayer and grants it; the Living Spirit descends and raises divine humanity; the building begins; the Five at the consummation glorify and intercede; the Third Ambassador chooses out the Living Soul; Jesus the Radiance completes the purpose-of-heart of the elements. The whole seven-state cycle is here remembered at the level of the soul — the cry that bears it, the answering powers sent, and the conjunction permanent. This is the seal: love strong as death, reaching through spiritual death to regenerate.
